name: What fire safety features are required?

mainEntity.name: What fire safety features are required?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fire-rated drywall between garage and conversion (1-hour rating typical), self-closing doors, draft stopping at ceiling, and sometimes sprinklers if near property lines.
